raised.$description: Inline code, hover, the current navigation item.

border.$description: Dividers and panel edges. Decorative, no contrast bar.

selection-border.$description: Dividers on the selection color, as under a chosen row. Decorative, no contrast bar.

field-border.$description: Input and button outlines. At least 3:1 on surface.

text-faint.$description: Rules, idle indicators and disabled text. At least 3:1, never body text.

brand.$description: The brand accent: tongue, cursor, prompt chevron, active markers. Graphics and large type.

brand-text.$description: Brand red as small text, such as the required mark of a field. Love on dark; on light love 0.05 further from the page in OKLab lightness, so it reads at 4.5:1.

brand-fill.$description: Solid chip behind small text, such as the mode segment.

interactive.$description: Links, the focus ring, checked controls and the primary button fill.

interactive-hover.$description: The interactive fill under the pointer, such as a hovered primary button: the interactive color 0.05 further from the page in OKLab lightness.

interactive-active.$description: The interactive fill while it is pressed: 0.1 further from the page in OKLab lightness.

tag-bg.$description: Tag background: the interactive color on the page, 12% of it in dark and 10% in light, as an opaque color.

tip.$description: Status tip and "active": bar and icon.

tip-tint.$description: Status tip: block background, the tip color at 9% on the page, as an opaque color.

note-tint.$description: Status note: block background, the note color at 9% on the page, as an opaque color.

warning-tint.$description: Status warning: block background, the warning color at 9% on the page, as an opaque color.

danger.$description: Status danger: field error border and bar.

danger-text.$description: Status danger: label and error message text.

danger-tint.$description: Status danger: block background, the danger color at 9% on the page, as an opaque color.
